blocks.text: Design and custom build of an executive office, 7 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) designed the interior and bespoke furniture for a 7 m² executive office.
A fully functional workspace had to fit into 7 m², so the interior and custom furniture were designed as a single whole, made to the exact dimensions of this room.
The gallery features 3D visualizations of the office.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN provides commercial interior design and bespoke furniture design for offices, executive offices, stores, boutiques, and beauty salons in Bratislava and Vienna.
